name: Veyondtech Gold Savings Scheme
author: Vimal Kava

sections.description:
Gold Scheme allows jewelry stores to run gold savings schemes where customers can pay monthly installments and redeem them for jewelry at the end of the term.

Features include:
* Create multiple types of savings schemes
* Fixed amount or gold weight based schemes
* Integration with WooCommerce for checkout and redemption
* KYC verification support
* Customer dashboard for tracking installments
* Admin dashboard for managing schemes and enrollments

External Services

This plugin relies on the following third-party external services:

  1. Razorpay Payment Gateway (API & Checkout SDK)

* Purpose: Used to securely create orders, accept installment payments, and verify transaction statuses.
* Data Sent: Customer order identifiers, payment amounts, currency, and customer billing details (email, phone) are sent when an installment payment is initiated or verified.
* Service Provider: Razorpay Software Private Limited
* Terms of Service: https://razorpay.com/terms/
* Privacy Policy: https://razorpay.com/privacy/

  1. Google Fonts

* Purpose: Enqueues and delivers the ‘Outfit’ font family for styling frontend schemes and dashboard typography.
* Data Sent: The visitor’s browser downloads stylesheets and font files directly from Google servers; standard HTTP request details (including visitor IP address and user agent) are processed by Google.
* Service Provider: Google LLC
* Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/veyondtech-gold-savings-scheme directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure the settings under the Gold Scheme menu in the admin dashboard.
